title: My Free Time
text:
I have a lot of free time on the weekend. I like to play football with my friends. We play in the park near my house. After the game, we eat ice cream.

On Sunday I stay at home. I like to read books and draw pictures. My sister likes music. She plays the piano every evening.

questions.text: Where do the writer and their friends play football?
options: In the park near the house

questions.text: What does the writer's sister like?
What kind of person is the writer most likely to be?
options: Someone who likes to be active with friends
Someone who never has free time
Someone who does not like books

questions.text: What can we guess about the writer's family?
options: They all like the same hobbies
They have different free time activities

vocabulary.definition: Saturday and Sunday, the two days at the end of the week
a sport played by two teams with a round ball
a musical instrument with black and white keys

paragraph_translations: Mam dużo wolnego czasu w weekend. Lubię grać w piłkę nożną z przyjaciółmi. Gramy w parku blisko mojego domu. Po meczu jemy lody.
W niedzielę zostaję w domu. Lubię czytać książki i rysować obrazki. Moja siostra lubi muzykę. Ona gra na pianinie każdego wieczoru.
